note: Both sets correctly capture the three general sheet notes (waste pipe slope per 2009 IRC, PVC for supply and waste pipe) with supporting quotes. Set B additionally extracts the elevation markers (INT. STEP 2'-6 1/8", FINISH FLOOR 2'-0 3/8") relative to the 0" ground plane datum and the 1/2" = 1'-0" scale of the Water Supply Longitudinal Section, all of which are supported by the text layer and image. Set A omits these facts without adding any errors, so B is the more complete and equally faithful extraction.
